_description: 2025 full-year out-of-sample validation. Same v7 parameters (H1+H4+H5). Covers full regime cycle: DeepSeek shock (Jan), tariff near-bear (Apr), recovery rally (May-Jun), NVDA $5T bull (Jul-Oct). Fresh $50k start.
notes: OUT-OF-SAMPLE: All hypotheses (H1/H4/H5) developed on 2024 data. True forward validation.
Jan 27: DeepSeek shock - AI confidence hit, CASH/REDUCED day expected
Apr 2-9: Tariff announcement, near-bear market (-19% peak-to-trough)
May-Jun: Recovery rally back to pre-tariff levels
Jul-Oct: New all-time highs weekly, NVDA $4T->$5T, strong momentum regime
Key H5 test: Does 10d cap cut losses faster during April tariff shock?
Key H1 test: Does deployment floor over-deploy into deteriorating regime?
Key H4 test: Does momentum weighting capture NVDA/AI bull run in H2?
Compare final return to: 2024 v7 full year (run baseline_full_2024_v7).
max_api_calls raised to 5000 for full year (252 days x ~4 calls avg = ~1000 actual).
